rationale: The first reply correctly refused DIY on gas parts, named the flame-failure device as the likely cause and advised a Gas Safe engineer, which fits the ground truth. The second reply was a generic gas-emergency block that largely ignored the customer's detail (brief smell only while lighting, CO alarm silent, no smell at rest).
